description: Engineering screening assumptions, not measured material properties, heat-transfer coefficients or device power. All conductances are W/K. Ambient is 25 C; temperatures are rises above ambient.
sensor_self_heat_basis: 3.3 V times 19 mA average at one measurement per 2 s, SCD30 datasheet p1/p2. Breakout overhead is omitted. The same self-heat is retained in both comparison solves.

rationale.H_ambient: Exterior area about 0.017 m2 times an assumed combined natural-convection/radiation coefficient, plus unmeasured ventilation. No calculated airflow is claimed.
rationale.H_C: Effective upper-bay air/radiation and wall/screw conduction to the outer carrier; not just plastic conduction.
rationale.H_M: Warm bay air and radiation directly heat the central mounting region. This bypass remains even with perimeter slots: about 0.00147 m2 times an effective 8 W/m2K nominally.
rationale.C_ambient: Effective radiation from exposed outer-carrier underside, including restricted view to the table/room.
rationale.C_A_and_M_A: Natural convection from carrier surfaces to under-skirt air; allocated separately from effective radiative areas.
rationale.M_S: Four printed bosses plus two M2 steel screw paths, PCB contact/spreading and inter-surface radiation, lumped. Not a measured contact resistance.
rationale.S_A: Effective sensor/PCB exposed area about 0.003 m2 times 2 to 6.7 W/m2K natural convection.
rationale.S_ambient: Effective linearized sensor radiation, with restricted view factor. At 25 C, 4 epsilon sigma T^3 is about 5 W/m2K for epsilon about 0.85.
rationale.A_ambient: Unmeasured under-skirt air exchange; about 0.017 to 0.083 L/s equivalent at rho cp about 1200 J/m3K. Sweep does not establish real airflow.
rationale.H_A: Small existing leakage from upper bay around carrier/through cable aperture.
rationale.slot_extra_H_A: Added allowance for warm-air leakage through new slots, 0 to 0.003 W/K. Prevents silently assuming slots only help; larger leakage can erase the gain.
rationale.H_S_wire: Four assumed 0.08 mm2 copper wires, 100 mm long, k=390 W/mK: kA/L approximately 0.00125 W/K. Wire gauge is unverified; this is an assumed bypass path.
rationale.plastic_k: Broad assumed effective printed-plastic conductivity range. Actual PLA/PETG filament, infill, print direction and contacts are unmeasured. The comparison does not select one material as thermally validated.

case_notes: Power is an assumed total upper-bay heat load, excluding the SCD30. 1.5 W is a stress allowance, NOT a measured charging load or board current rating. Solar absorptance is hypothetical, not certified by colour; only horizontal top-area absorption is included. Side sunlight, table heating and direct sensor irradiation are omitted.

sources.supports: 19 mA average at 2 s, 3.3 V default test conditions; does not supply enclosure coefficients.
Separation from heat sources, below-source placement, ambient coupling, shade, residual temperature compensation.
USB operation can also charge the connected battery; regulator heat matters. No measured full-device heat load is supplied here.
